name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Watch parties with friends: in the group (SyncPlay) menu at the top, choose "New group with friends" (or "Invite friends" in a group). Your friends' viewers find the party in their own group list and join it like any group, from any app that supports group watching, while everyone plays their own server's copy. Play, pause, seeking and title changes are shared, and anyone loading or buffering pauses everyone until they're ready. Each viewer still needs access to what's playing. Switches under Advanced. Both servers need 0.0.189.
